prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing a bustling snowy town square. In the center stands a stone fountain capped with white snow. To the left of the fountain, a woman in a blue coat holds a steaming cup of coffee. Next to her sits a black cat on a wooden bench, its tail curled tightly around its paws. A man in a red scarf walks past them, his head turned to look at the cat. On the right side of the scene, a brown dog tugs playfully at the leash held by a child in a yellow hat. The child points excitedly toward a street vendor selling roasted chestnuts from a small cart. The vendor, an older man with a gray beard, hands a paper bag to a teenager in a green jacket. Behind the vendor, a large oak tree stretches bare branches into the pale sky. Perched on one lower branch is a crow, watching the scene below. Near the base of the tree, a bicycle leans against the trunk, its tires half-buried in drifts. A police officer in a dark uniform stands near the bicycle, writing in a notebook. Beside the officer, a pigeon pecks at crumbs on the cobblestones. In the background, a clock tower rises above the rooftops, its face showing three o'clock. A couple walks arm in arm beneath the tower, the woman wearing a pink beret and the man carrying a violin case. There is no sun visible in the sky. There is no car present in the square.
